title: Canonical composition arrow for a finite-horizontal compact-support square
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring, and use the intrinsic small-pro-etale ordinary pullback/direct-image operations [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] and open extension by zero [def-weil-extension-by-zero]. For a Cartesian square [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square] with arrows $r:U\to W$, $k:U\to V$, $i:W\to T$, $p:V\to T$, where $i,k$ are open immersions, define $\gamma:i_!Rr_*\to Rp_*k_!$ to be the published canonical open-adjunction transpose of inverse derived sectionwise restriction: first the unit of $k_!\dashv k^*$, then inverse restriction $i^*Rp_*\simeq Rr_*k^*$, then the counit of $i_!\dashv i^*$. For a Cartesian square with arrows $p:X'\to X$, $f':X'\to Y'$, $f:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$ and a compactification $c=(j,b)$ of $f$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], let $c'=(j',b')$ be its base change and $q:Z'\to Z$ its proper ambient horizontal arrow. With the chosen compact-support functors $Rf_!^c=Rb_*j_!$ and $Rf'_!^{c'}=Rb'_*j'_!$ [def-compact-support-direct-image-detailed], define $\chi:Rf_!^c Rp_*\to Rg_*Rf'_!^{c'}$ as $Rb_*(\gamma)$ followed by $\sigma$, where $\sigma:Rb_*Rq_*\simeq Rg_*Rb'_*$ is the conjugate [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate] of the canonical pullback-square isomorphism under the composite ordinary adjunctions [def-weil-pbc-composite-adjunction]. Insert the functor associators. This defines the arrow on all unbounded objects; it makes no assertion of invertibility or compactification independence. Positive-level rings in [def-trf-coefficient-conventions] are made finite by the recorded theorem of [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], with no added finiteness hypothesis. For the positive-level coefficient ring, use the existing intrinsic pro-etale finite-Tor constructible predicate of [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], reexported by a transparent alias, as the domain of the mate identity.
